name: EPIC 248810986
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 10.7 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248810986 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.712537 (16th-84th percentiles 10.242116-11.298197), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 6,627 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.90 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,720 K at its surface.
